name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_LINE_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in validate customer contracts source data job during internal processing.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether source document line is eligible to be part of customer contract or not.

columns.name: DIMENSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether pricing combination is successfully derived for the given document line or not.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document, such as book date for sales order, or invoice date for invoice.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: DEFAULT_SATIS_MEASURE_MODEL
columns.description: Default satisfaction measurement model to be used when the revenue rule is not provided from the source product.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Source document line type for a project line. Possible values are ORIGINAL for initial baselined approved version, and REVISION for subsequent changes including changes to the revenue budget or for project status changed to closed.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Source document line number in source application.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_CODE
columns.description: Item inventory organization code of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Item inventory organization identifier of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: SOURCE_ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Inventory item number in source application. This column is used to correct data transformation errors.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Inventory item identifier on source document line. For a single source line, pass values in either ITEM_ID or MEMO_LINE_SEQ_ID columns, but not both.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Inventory item numeric identifier on source document line.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_NAME
columns.description: Memo line name of source document line.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Memo line identifier on source document line.

columns.name: ITEM_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Item group internal identifier.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. Possible values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Item type unique identifier. Value populated in this column is related to the primary key of the entity provided in ITEM_TYPE.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue price profile internal identifier

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a template assignment.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the template is in-used and cannot be deleted. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ASSIGN_IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the template assignment is in-used and cannot be deleted. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of source document. This value must match currency codes in Oracle Fusion General Ledger.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: List price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Extended line amount on source document line.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Discount amount of the source document line.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage discount of unit selling price of inventory item or memo line on source document line. This column is used in FMV calculations and compliance processing.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line as percentage of base price.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: List price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line as percentage of base price.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cost of inventory item or memo line. This column is used to calculate gross margin percent.

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Gross margin percentage for a source line. This column is used in fair market value computation for gross margin percent FMV representation type.

columns.name: REVISED_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Revised unit of measure code of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of source document line.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the source document line after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Net unit list price discount used to validate VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Net discount amount of the original line.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_PERCENT
columns.description: Discount percentage after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit sales percent base price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Net base price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost of sale after the document is revised.

columns.name: REVISED_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Adjusted gross margin of sales after the document is revised.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of source document.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Accounting rule name on the source document line.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule identifier on source document line. Revenue scheduling rule determines the timing of revenue recognition.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the revenue scheduling rule. This rule needs to be defaulted on the performance obligation line if no rule is provided by the source application.

columns.name: RULE_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition start date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: RULE_END_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition end date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_BILL_TO_CUST_REF

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_BILL_TO_CUST_SITE_REF

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_PARTY_NUM

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_PARTY_NAME

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Account identifier of bill-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NUM
columns.description: Account number of bill-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUST_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Customer classification of bill-to customer on source document line. Values are from the lookup CUSTOMER_CLASS. Value at source document line level takes precedence over value at source document level.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_SITE_ID

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_ID

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_NUM

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_SITE_ID

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document line version when document versioning is supported. For example, original is 1 and revisions are 2 or more. VERSION_FLAG must be populated when version number is greater than 1.

columns.name: VERSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current source product line is a version line. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: LAST_VERSION_FLAG

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_TO_CREDIT
columns.description: Latest source document line version when document versioning is supported. For example, original is 1 and revisions are 2 or more.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a new line from the source system should be added to an existing contract. Blank is equivalent to N.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how a new line from the source system should be processed. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION. Blank is equivalent to ORA_ADD_TO_EXISTING_PO.

columns.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contract review should be queued for manual review. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: REVISION_INTENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Revision intent for the source document revision line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REVISION_INTENT_CODE
columns.description: Default revision intent for the source document type. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the top most parent document line for the current line.

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the parent is a root node. Y means that the parent in the relationship is at the root node. N means that the parent is not at the root node.

columns.name: PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of top most parent document line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Specifies message name for warning line.

columns.name: LINE_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time when the source document line was created.

columns.name: LINE_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time when the source document line was created.

columns.name: REV_REC_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a document line to indicate whether line is processed by revenue.

columns.name: SRC_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID

columns.name: RECURRING_FREQUENCY

columns.name: RECURRING_AMOUNT

columns.name: APPLIED_BILL_ENTERED_AMT
